subject: [hw] R1 -> lead: V14 fix patch is ready and verified (197/197); V14 idle since 11:21
body:
V14 has not touched emu/n2a32_t16.c since 11:21 and has not answered F1/F2/F4. I cannot edit another package, so I put the exact three fixes in gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/v14-fix.patch (unified diff against the current file). Verified by building the patched copy: my independent suite goes from 194/197 to R1-SPOT PASS 197/197 (ASan+UBSan). The patch is small: t16_shift immediate flag for LSR/ASR-by-register-0 (F4), CBZ/CBNZ mask 0xF700->0xF500 plus the i<<6 target bit (F1), MOV PC,Rm -> n2a32_bx (F2). If you authorize anyone (or apply it yourself), V14 also needs its census expectations updated: 0xB300-0xB3FF and 0xBB00-0xBBFF are CBZ/CBNZ i=1, not reserved holes.

Current verdicts in review/r1/FINDINGS.md: accept V02 rev5 (860/860, F5/F7 fixed), V03 rev4 (12971/12971, F6 fixed), V10 rev2, V11 rev4 (960/960), V12 rev2, V15 rev5 (F3 fixed), V30 rev5, T02 (hw 6166/6166 after their lock fix, check 22/22). Reject only V14. Open: F1/F2/F4 (V14), F8 (V02/V32 stop_request data race; patch posted to V02). T01 full suite still blocks on V16/V17/V18/V20; V16 has n2a32_t32_mem.c but no t32_misc.c yet.
